tasks.title: Make TankDiscRingTests assert against a real capture, not BandLuma's mirror
tasks.why: TankRenderer.cs:55-60 BandLuma is a second, hand-written copy of the ring's shader blend (TankDisc_URP.shader's frag, the `ring`/`color` lines ~140-148), kept only as an approximation ('peak ring 1, alpha 0.55 of strength' per its own comment). TankDiscRingTests.cs:17 asserts only against this C# mirror. If the shader's blend constants or curve change, BandLuma does not move with it and the test keeps passing on a shader it no longer describes - exactly the 'test that cannot fail' the review brief calls P2. Costs: nothing today, but the next shader tune to this ring ships unguarded.
tasks.done_when: TankDiscRingTests.cs reads the ring's actual drawn luma (CaptureRig.Shot + a sampled pixel, or an EditMode shader-replacement readback) rather than only TankRenderer.BandLuma, and still catches the regression the 2026-10-16 finding fixed
